title: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Ophthalmic Visual Question Answering with OphthalWeChat

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy and text generation quality (BLEU-1, BERTScore) of vision-language models between English and Chinese question-answering subsets using statistical tests (e.g., chi-square test) to identify cross-lingual performance disparities.

Measuring the skewed distribution of correct answers in binary (True/False) and single-choice (A/B/C/D) generated questions and mitigating it through controlled option-swapping and semantic negation to ensure a balanced dataset for model evaluation.
